LESSON: TIME

Grade: PP2
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.5: Time

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Time. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Which are the days of week?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. use vocabulary related to time for effective communication
2. observe tools used for telling time
3. name tools used for telling time (clock 71 ;calendar; mobile phone; animals and birds) e) name the days of the week and the months of the year f) appreciate management of time when doing different activities

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. use vocabulary related to time for effective communication
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to use vocabulary related to time for effective communication. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. observe tools used for telling time
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to observe tools used for telling time. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. name tools used for telling time (clock 71 ;calendar; mobile phone; animals and birds) e) name the days of the week and the months of the year f) appreciate management of time when doing different activities
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to name tools used for telling time (clock 71 ;calendar; mobile phone; animals and birds) e) name the days of the week and the months of the year f) appreciate management of time when doing different activities. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At the market in your county, count 10 mangoes. Put them in 2 groups of 5. That is sorting and grouping.

Example 2: In class, count the desks in your row. Write the number in figures and in words.

Example 3: If you have 7 shillings and your parent gives you 5 more, you have 12 shillings. That is addition.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Time.
2. Explain Time to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Time.
4. Show that you can: use vocabulary related to time for effective communication
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Time. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Which are the days of week?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. use vocabulary related to time for effective communication
2. observe tools used for telling time
3. name tools used for telling time (clock 71 ;calendar; mobile phone; animals and birds) e) name the days of the week and the months of the year f) appreciate management of time when doing different activities

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
